## Looking Back at October 14

Here's the thing about playoff baseball—it doesn't care about your percentages. We had one game on the slate yesterday, and the model liked the Dodgers at 56%. They didn't pull through, and that's the reality of October. Every pitch matters, every swing can change everything.

## What Happened

The Brewers came into Chavez Ravine and took care of business. Sometimes in this game, the underdog has the better night, and that's exactly what happened. The model saw a slight edge for the Dodgers at home, but Milwaukee had other plans.

This is why we love October baseball—it's unpredictable, it's dramatic, and it reminds us that nothing is guaranteed.

## Tomorrow's Top Pick: October 15

Now let's turn the page to October 15, where we've got an intriguing matchup between the Tampa Bay Rays and Cleveland Guardians. The model is giving us a lean toward Tampa Bay, and while it's not a screaming pick at 54%, there's a story here worth paying attention to.

## The Pitching Matchup

Griffin Jax takes the mound for Tampa Bay, going up against Gavin Williams for Cleveland. This is the kind of matchup where the margins are razor-thin, which is why we're seeing a 54% edge rather than something more decisive.

Jax has been solid for the Rays, and Williams brings his own arsenal for the Guardians. The model sees a slight advantage for Tampa Bay, likely factoring in recent form and matchup dynamics.

## The Bottom Line

Yesterday didn't go our way, but that's part of the journey. Every miss teaches us something, every game gives us more data, and every new day brings fresh opportunities.

For October 15, we're riding with Tampa Bay in what should be a competitive game. The 54% confidence tells you everything you need to know—this one could go either way, but the model sees a slight edge for the Rays.

Let's see what tomorrow brings. That's the beauty of baseball—there's always another game, another chance, another story waiting to unfold.
